title: Decoupled Drift-Diffusion World Models for Consistent Future Frame Prediction
title_zh: 解耦漂移-扩散世界模型：实现一致的未来帧预测

paragraphs.en: 解耦漂移-扩散世界模型通过联合回归确定性下一状态预测与空间不确定性图，实现一致的未来帧预测。 World models of visual information predict future image frames conditioned on given action sequences. This predicted scene evolution is driven by deterministic changes such as controlled motion on a robot platform, as well as stochastic changes such as rendering of manipulated objects or previously occluded regions. Our key insight is that the spatial location of these stochastic changes is itself learnable. We leverage this insight by jointly regressing both the deterministic next-state prediction and the spatial uncertainty map, then using the uncertainty map to guide a conditional diffusion process. We propose Decoupled Drift-Diffusion World Model (D3WM), which uses a transformer trained with a Gaussian negative-log-likelihood objective to produce both the deterministic next-state prediction and a spatial map of heteroscedastic aleatoric uncertainty. The learned uncertainty map then provides a structured spatial gate for a conditional diffusion model: deterministic regions are anchored to the predicted state, while uncertain regions, such as disocclusions or dynamic textures, are sampled by the diffusion process. We frame this decomposition under a variance-gated stochastic differential equation that separates deterministic drift from stochastic diffusion. D3WM shows improved results over competitive baselines in two distinct types of action spaces: robotic tabletop manipulation and camera motion.
paragraphs.zh: 解耦漂移-扩散世界模型通过联合回归确定性下一状态预测与空间不确定性图，实现一致的未来帧预测。视觉信息的世界模型会根据给定的动作序列预测未来的图像帧。 这种预测的场景演化由确定性变化（例如机器人平台上的受控运动）和随机性变化（例如被操控物体的渲染或先前被遮挡区域的显现）共同驱动。 我们的关键洞见是，这些随机性变化的空间位置本身也是可学习的。 我们通过联合回归确定性下一状态预测与空间不确定性图来利用这一洞见，然后使用不确定性图引导条件扩散过程。 我们提出了解耦漂移-扩散世界模型（D3WM），该模型使用一个基于高斯负对数似然目标训练的变换器，以生成确定性下一状态预测和异方差随机不确定性空间图。 学习到的不确定性图随后为条件扩散模型提供了一个结构化的空间门控：确定性区域锚定在预测状态上，而不确定区域（例如重新显现的区域或动态纹理）则由扩散过程进行采样。 我们将这种分解置于一个具有方差门控的随机微分方程框架下，该方程将确定性漂移与随机性扩散分离开来。 D3WM 在两种不同类型的动作空间中优于现有的竞争基线模型：机器人桌面操控和相机运动。
